spans.s:
ऐरंमद ऐरंमद, अस्, m. (fr. इरंमद),
a patronymic of Deva-muni, author of a Ṛg-veda
hymn.

ऐरंमदीय, अम्, n., N. of a sea in Brahmā's
world.

ऐरावण ऐरावण, अस्, m. (fr. इरा-वन् =
इरा-वत्, ‘possessed of or proceeding from water’),
N. of a king of the Nāgas; Indra's elephant, pro-
duced at the churning of the ocean.

ऐरावत, अस्, m. a patronymic of a fabulous serpent-
like being called Dhṛta-rāṣṭra; a serpent, one of the
chiefs of the Nāgas or serpent-race, inhabiting the
lower world or Pātāla; N. of the elephant of Indra,
produced at the churning of the ocean, and the pro-
totype of the elephant race, considered also as the
elephant of the east quarter; [cf. नाग, which means
both serpent and elephant]; an excellent elephant;
(अस्, अम्), m. n. a kind of rainbow, considered as the
long and unbent bow of Indra; a kind of lightning;
(अस्), m. the orange tree; another tree, Artocarpus
Lacucha; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a vast and waterless
region; (आनि), n. pl., N. of a Varṣa; N. of the
northern path of the moon; the fruit of the tree
Artocarpus Lacucha; (ई), f. the female of Indra's
elephant; lightning; N. of a plant; N. of the Ravi
[]
river in the Pañjāb; N. of a particular portion of the
moon's path.
